Build succeeded. Created `/workspace/middleware.ts`:

- Logs `request.nextUrl.pathname` to the console on every matched request
- Generates a unique `X-Request-Id` header via `crypto.randomUUID()` and attaches it to the response
- Uses a `matcher` config to skip static assets (`_next/static`, `_next/image`, `favicon.ico`)
